title: Same-action bounded Verify → Repair loop
owner: EF01 Engineering Execution; EF02 result integration
objective: Trong một EF02 action/claim, trả kết quả verify thất bại có chẩn đoán cho chính executor đã chọn, sửa trên worktree cũ, verify lại và trả một aggregate result.

design.invocation_evidence: distinct local invocation_id, exit code, usage observation, verify logs, diff and SHA per call; immutable EF02 action/claim identity preserved
feedback_payload: full available stdout/stderr logs by artifact reference
design.selection: Keep exact Human selected executor/model/effort, no cross-provider fallback
design.allowed_trigger: Ordinary completed provider invocation with determinate scoped code verification failure and safe scoped workspace
design.result: No candidate until current worktree final scope+source+hash+verify success; log each round with truthful usage and stop reason

acceptance: With fake executors, verify fails first and succeeds after one scoped repair: one EF02 claim, two distinct invocation records, one final candidate, exact selected model/effort unchanged.
With repeated determinate verify failure, bounded rounds stop, preserve all diagnostics and never publish a success candidate.
UNKNOWN/timeout/permission/quota/out-of-scope/source drift never triggers another provider call or silently elevates status.
Concurrent EF02 sibling actions retain independent worktrees, per-action results and DAG correctness.
non_goals: Claim that re-invoking a CLI preserves an identical vendor chat session
